waived.title: An unrecognised status word decides the headline, and it can fail in either direction
waived.why: The phrase "still broken" appears inside a quotation of reckon's reasoning about a status word list — "a half still broken owes a reproduction for that half" — and describes what partially-fixed means, not an unrepaired arm of this defect. This row's own subject, the word list, was corrected.

waived.title: Three files named for the takeover shield contain no image at all
waived.why: "RECORDED rather than fixed" here attaches to the UNDERLYING capture-channel fault, which belongs to CASE-0059, not to this row. This row's subject was three files claiming the takeover shield with nothing declaring them, and the note says "Now declared".

vocabulary.open: measured and still failing — stays in the owing set
vocabulary.fixed: measured, repaired, and a case watches the repair — leaves the owing set
vocabulary.partially-fixed: one arm repaired and another recorded — stays in the owing set
vocabulary.closed: ended without a repair, because the subject went away — leaves the owing set
